about_the_game:
Enter a cooperative nightmare for 1 to 6 players, where survival depends on quick thinking and true teamwork. Trapped inside a vast labyrinthine hotel, you are relentlessly hunted by a towering teddy bear. Among countless doors, only one hides the firearm that can turn the tide—if you manage to find it before it’s too late.

Hide, run, explore, and combine strategies to delay the inevitable. The threat never stops, and only coordination and collective intelligence can keep you alive.

With its unsettling minimalist style—a disturbing mix of cartoon and realism—the game amplifies fear through eerie lighting, tense soundscapes, sudden action, and thunderous gunfire. An immersive horror experience where every choice matters, and terror is best faced together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: SSD 64-bit
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Install on SSD

short_description: Survive in a sealed hospital where a giant Teddy hunts you nonstop. Play solo or co-op up to 6. Teddy hears the slightest sound and gets faster every minute. Your footsteps, doors, objects… anything can draw him in. Search the rooms: only one holds the weapon that can neutralize him.
